title: Racket Stringing Service Due-Soon Queue
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stringing:service
| eval days_to_due=round((next_restring_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where days_to_due>=0 AND days_to_due<=14 AND service_status!="done"
| table _time racket_name service_status days_to_due
| sort days_to_due
description: Builds a queue of stringing jobs that are due soon but not yet marked complete.
value: Due-soon queues are what keep small admin tasks from turning into expensive or embarrassing misses.
implementation: Populate `next_restring_epoch` and normalize `service_status` so the queue only shows genuinely actionable work.
visualization: Table of due-soon stringing jobs sorted by days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which stringing jobs are coming due soon and still need attention.
